question: Find the display names of users who have posted at least one comment with a score of 0 and who also own at least one post that has fewer than 100 views. Return each qualifying user only once.

prediction.sql: SELECT DISTINCT u."XCL_055" FROM users AS u WHERE u."XCL_052" IN (SELECT c."XCL_010" FROM comments AS c WHERE c."XCL_007" = 0) AND u."XCL_052" IN (SELECT p."XCL_033" FROM posts AS p WHERE p."XCL_030" < 100)

semantic_memory.interpretation_policy: Assignments are conditional on the proposed role vocabulary; feasibility is not independent validation of business labels. Use original historical SQL and physical observations to compare competing interpretations.

arguments.sql:
SELECT DISTINCT u."XCL_055"
FROM users AS u
WHERE EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM comments AS c
    WHERE c."XCL_010" = u."XCL_052"
      AND c."XCL_007" = 0
)
AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM posts AS p
    WHERE p."XCL_033" = u."XCL_052"
      AND p."XCL_030" < 100
)
